shots.description: 0-26.5 s, one continuous diorama on black. A soft elliptical light pool behind a minimal level: two thin dark slabs with bright top edges at mid-frame, a dashed baseline and a thin measuring line with end ticks; a small glowing white figure (disc head, rounded bell body, arm stubs) hops along a dotted parabola and lands one step short, falling. A dark pill tag above names who plays (FRIEND, later YOU); line-art hands hold a grey device below. At 17 s the frame splits down the middle by a 2 px divider: FRIEND left, YOU right, the same failed hop replayed in both halves; under them pill chips: a bright white chip with the useful advice words on the left, a chip with the harsh words that dims to grey on the right.

narrative.point: A tiny symbolic failure shown twice: once to a friend who gets a calm instruction, once to you who gets an insult; the split replay asks why the two answers differ

lighting.lighting_overall: One soft elliptical light pool behind the subject on a pure black frame; emissive white figure with bloom; warm lamp cone only in the room scene

grade.grade_overall: Near-monochrome: pure black, neutral greys and white; colour only in a mint expectation curve, its red crash, a warm lamp, and one full-colour reveal near the end

editing.editing: Long held scenes with slow push-ins and pull-outs, morphs (a graph plate turning into a screen), zooms into screens and pictures, fades through black between symbol and real life; ends on its own opening composition

format.format: Vertical 9:16 code-rendered second-person parable, TTS voice-over over a soft music bed, burned-in full-line captions under the picture

style.render_style: Minimal 2D motion graphics on pure black: a glowing white figure on small diorama sets, line-art props, pill chips, a glowing data curve; one shaded 3D object near the end
style.outline: Props and devices: dark fills with 2 px pale grey outlines; slabs: no outline but a 3 px bright top-edge highlight; the figure has no outline, only a soft white bloom
style.shading: Flat fills in 2 or 3 neutral greys; glow on the figure and the curve; one soft light pool per scene; no textures
style.shape_language: Discs, rounded bells, thin bevelled slabs, dotted arcs, measuring ticks, rounded pill chips, outlined numerals
style.texture: None: clean vector, faint perspective grid on the graph plate, dashed baselines
style.type_ui: Small uppercase bold pill chips (dark with a grey border for who is who; white with dark text for spoken words); a large white sentence-case caption of the full spoken line centred under the picture; outlined numerals
style.motion_style: Calm and slow: hops along visible dotted arcs, identical replays, chips popping in, a curve drawing itself with a counter on its tip, colour sweeping along the curve on the turn, slow camera push-ins and pull-outs
style.signature: The same tiny failure shown to a FRIEND and to YOU, replayed side by side with two different chips; monochrome until one full-colour reveal; the reel returns to its first scene
style.do_not_copy: The topic (self-talk after a failed jump and a failed product launch), the game controller, the platforms and jump, the desk mat, the laptop and phone UIs, the words and numbers on screen, any handle or watermark

story.summary: A second-person parable: your friend fails at a small thing and you give a calm, exact instruction; you fail the same way and insult yourself; replayed side by side the double standard is obvious. The same happens in real life (a launch that flops, a harsh verdict alone at night). Imagined as a friend's work, the useful advice comes at once. Ends back in the first scene: say it to yourself, then retry.
story.hook: A tiny relatable failure in a symbolic scene with a direct question from a friend, in plain second person
highlights: Side-by-side replay (17-26 s): identical failures, two different chips
Expectation curve turning red and collapsing to zero (31-39 s)
Pull-out from a lit window to a dark building (42-45 s): loneliness of the verdict
Colour reveal of the hidden good (49-55 s), the only colour in the reel
Returns to the opening scene with the advice applied (55-60 s)
